name: Native triangular mesh area quantification
purpose: Quantify the geometric surface area of existing native triangular white/pial meshes, distinguishing it from software-reported ROI area or local gyrification.

inputs.statement: A FreeSurfer surface mesh file in triangular format, e.g., white or pial surface.
inputs.quote: Read a triangular format Freesurfer surface mesh.

inputs.statement: Vertex coordinates array (nvtx x 3) from the surface mesh.
inputs.quote: nvtx x 3 array of vertex (x, y, z) coordinates.

inputs.statement: Face array (nfaces x 3) defining mesh triangles.
inputs.quote: nfaces x 3 array of defining mesh triangles.

inputs.statement: Triangle vertices in (n, 3, 3) float form for area computation.
inputs.quote: Functions for dealing with triangle soups in (n, 3, 3) float form.

conditions.statement: The mesh must be in triangular format as read by nibabel's read_geometry.
conditions.quote: Read a triangular format Freesurfer surface mesh.

conditions.statement: Triangle vertices must be provided as an (n, 3, 3) float array for area calculation.
The area function computes the sum area of input triangles.
conditions.quote: Calculates the sum area of input triangles

steps.statement: Convert the vertex and face arrays into a triangle soup of shape (n, 3, 3) float, where each triangle is defined by its three vertices.
steps.quote: Functions for dealing with triangle soups in (n, 3, 3) float form.

steps.statement: Interpret the returned summed area as the geometric surface area of the mesh.
steps.quote: area – Individual or summed area depending on sum argument

checks.statement: Verify that the mesh is in triangular format as expected by read_geometry.
checks.quote: Read a triangular format Freesurfer surface mesh.

checks.statement: Ensure the triangle array is in (n, 3, 3) float form before calling area.
Confirm that the area function returns the summed area, not individual triangle areas, when the sum argument is used.
checks.quote: sum (bool) – Return summed area or individual triangle area

exceptions.statement: The area function may accept precomputed cross products as a speedup, but this is optional.
exceptions.quote: crosses ((n, 3) float or None) – As a speedup don’t re- compute cross products

outputs.statement: A float value representing the summed geometric area of the mesh triangles.
outputs.quote: area – Individual or summed area depending on sum argument

parameters.statement: The sum argument controls whether the area function returns summed area or individual triangle areas.
parameters.quote: sum (bool) – Return summed area or individual triangle area

parameters.statement: The crosses argument can be provided as a speedup to avoid recomputing cross products.
parameters.quote: crosses ((n, 3) float or None) – As a speedup don’t re- compute cross products

claim.statement: Load the surface mesh using nibabel.freesurfer.io.read_geometry to obtain vertex coordinates and face definitions.
claim.quote: read_geometry(filepath[, read_metadata, ...]) Read a triangular format Freesurfer surface mesh.

claim.statement: Extract the vertex coordinates array (nvtx x 3) from the loaded mesh.
claim.quote: coords numpy array nvtx x 3 array of vertex (x, y, z) coordinates.

claim.statement: Extract the face array (nfaces x 3) defining mesh triangles.
claim.quote: faces numpy array nfaces x 3 array of defining mesh triangles.

claim.statement: Call trimesh.triangles.area with the triangle array to compute the summed area.
claim.quote: trimesh.triangles.area(triangles=None, crosses=None) Calculates the sum area of input triangles

claim.statement: The area function can return either summed area or individual triangle areas depending on the sum argument.
claim.quote: Returns: area – Individual or summed area depending on sum argument

claim.statement: The vertex coordinates array (nvtx x 3) from the mesh.
claim.quote: coords numpy array nvtx x 3 array of vertex (x, y, z) coordinates.

claim.statement: The face array (nfaces x 3) defining mesh triangles.
claim.quote: faces numpy array nfaces x 3 array of defining mesh triangles.
